title: Analytical commentary (FIT5205 A1)
scale_note: Points per level as stated in the rubric; Unsatisfactory covers 0 up to its stated maximum.

levels.label: Very Good
levels.description: Nuanced, comprehensive description demonstrating sophisticated research and keen insight into data-related concerns.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Clear, accurate description covering the majority of important points and relevant data issues.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Adequate overview capturing most key aspects; minor omissions or inaccuracies.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Partial or uneven coverage with notable gaps; limited awareness of data issues.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Superficial or incorrect description; little or no recognition of data considerations.

levels.label: Very Good
levels.description: Thorough, perceptive mapping of arguments; evaluates evidence with depth and originality.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Solid identification of arguments supported by clear explanation of evidence.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Basic identification of main arguments and corresponding evidence; may lack depth.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Incomplete or partially correct identification; explanation lacks clarity.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Arguments misconstrued or missing; evidence not addressed.

levels.label: Very Good
levels.description: Demonstrates excellent understanding of the framework; applies it insightfully to build a compelling critique.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Shows substantial understanding; applies the framework effectively to the article.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Competent use of the framework; evaluation occasionally descriptive rather than analytical.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Limited grasp of the framework; application is superficial.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Minimal or erroneous use of ethical framework.

levels.label: Very Good
levels.description: Writing is polished and well structured; virtually no language errors; exemplary citation practice.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Writing is clear and logical; few language slips; referencing generally accurate.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Organisation and language acceptable; some errors; citations mostly correct.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Disorganised writing; frequent errors; referencing problems evident.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Disjointed prose; pervasive errors; serious citation shortcomings or evidence of plagiarism.
